description: This file defines an abstract base class `BaseAnthropicMessagesConfig` which provides an interface for configuring and transforming Anthropic messages within a language model framework. It includes abstract methods for validation, URL generation, request transformation, and response transformation, as well as optional methods for signing requests and handling streaming responses.
